name: insert_tail
declaration: unsafe fn insert_tail < T , F : FnMut (& T , & T) -> bool > (begin : * mut T , tail : * mut T , is_less : & mut F)
documentation:
Sorts range [begin, tail] assuming [begin, tail) is already sorted.

 # Safety
 begin < tail and p must be valid and initialized for all begin <= p <= tail.
rules: For safety, every pointer `p` in the inclusive range `begin <= p <= tail` must be valid and point to an initialized `T`.
